truths.truth: A tree pass over a continuing session alone leaves continues_from NULL; a second tree pass that archives the predecessor fills it, though the later file was unchanged and not re-committed
truths.evidence: Sweep fill_continuations at crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:1559-1583 resolves through the shared parent_session_id (mod.rs:1522-1543, also called by continues_from at mod.rs:1509). Wired as the first step of Tree::after_walk at crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/pass.rs:345-347. Test a_continuing_session_is_linked_once_its_predecessor_is_archived (crates/terminus-core/tests/lineage.rs:283-296) asserts files_committed == 1 on pass two, so only the sweep can have linked it. It passed in the merged-tree suite (scratchpad full-suite.log line 1073: '... ok'). Mutation in an isolated git-archive copy of HEAD, replacing the call with 'summary.continuations = None;': the test FAILED at lineage.rs:296 with 'left: None, right: Some("00000001-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")'.

truths.truth: terminus show --json on the later session reports the predecessor in context.continues_from
truths.evidence: CLI spot-check with target/debug/terminus rebuilt at 19:43:47 (after HEAD d52eb75; crates/ clean in git status). HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, TERMINUS_DATA_DIR, TERMINUS_CONFIG_DIR and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR all pointed into the scratchpad. Pass 1 (later transcript alone, first record parentUuid cccccccc-...-000000000001): 'continues_from=NULL', run 'files_committed=1 error=NULL notes=NULL'. Pass 2 (predecessor added): 'continues_from=00000001-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', run 'files_committed=1 error=NULL notes=NULL'. 'terminus show 0 --after 1 --project * --json' printed '"context":{..."continues_from":"00000001-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"...}' with ok:true, exit 0. Read path: recall::context::window reads session_meta.continues_from (crates/terminus-core/src/recall/context.rs:109-117, 196); show emits it (crates/terminus/src/cmd/show.rs:249).

truths.truth: A session whose continues_from was already set keeps it through a later sweep; a sidecar resolving to its own session id is never self-linked
truths.evidence: The sweep selects only 'm.continues_from IS NULL' rows and its UPDATE also requires 'continues_from IS NULL' (crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:1564, 1578). Test a_link_already_recorded_survives_the_sweep (lineage.rs:301-313) passed in the merged suite (full-suite.log line 1070). Mutation in the scratch copy, dropping both NULL guards: the test FAILED at lineage.rs:312 with 'left: Some("00000001-..."), right: Some("00000009-...")', so the test discriminates. Extra CLI probe: a sidecar <uuid1>/subagents/agent-a.jsonl whose first turn's parent_uuid resolves into its parent file, ingested before the parent and then with it. Both session_meta rows kept continues_from NULL and the last run had error=NULL, so the self-link rule (mod.rs:1542) holds under the sweep.

truths.truth: A session retention::evaluate selected, whose transcript is back before retention::apply, keeps every row; apply deletes nothing; the kept session is a note, not an error
truths.evidence: delete_one reads session_meta.transcript_path inside its own transaction and returns Ok(None) before any delete when super::transcript_is_gone is false (crates/terminus-core/src/retention/apply.rs:193-206). transcript_is_gone counts only NotFound as gone (crates/terminus-core/src/retention/mod.rs:248-253). apply counts Ok(None) on Applied.kept, never on deleted or the notes field (apply.rs:120-133). notes() adds the kept line (apply.rs:98-104), and is_silent covers kept (apply.rs:53). Test a_transcript_that_comes_back_before_the_delete_keeps_its_session (crates/terminus-core/tests/retention.rs:594-632) asserts deleted empty, notes field empty, errors() empty, kept == 1, notes() line present, rows and FTS matches unchanged; it passed in the merged suite (full-suite.log line 1334). Mutation in the scratch copy, removing the check: the test FAILED at retention.rs:618 (assert applied.deleted.is_empty()). Seam into runs.notes: retain calls evaluate then apply (retention/mod.rs:281-290), pass.rs:379 stores it, and runs.rs:92 extends notes with summary.retention.notes(). That seam is carried end to end by a_pass_with_an_evict_policy_evicts_the_aged_sessions_and_says_so (crates/terminus-core/tests/pass.rs:740-772, passed, full-suite.log line 1146). Minor doc wording on Applied::kept (apply.rs:37-40) is already ticketed as #116.

truths.truth: apply.rs has no DELETE FROM for paths, entities, compactions, turns_fts or turns; delete_session calls reindex::clear_derived; the existing deletion tests pass unchanged
truths.evidence: 'grep -nE "DELETE FROM (paths|entities|compactions|turns_fts|turns)\b" crates/terminus-core/src/retention/apply.rs' printed nothing (exit 1). delete_session calls crate::reindex::clear_derived at apply.rs:212. 'pub(crate) fn clear_derived' is at crates/terminus-core/src/reindex.rs:245, with the same five statements in the same order (reindex.rs:246-256; the phase diff changes only the signature line and docs). Existing deletion tests passed in the merged suite: a_deletion_removes_every_row_the_session_owns (log 1335), a_decision_naming_the_deleted_session_survives_it (1332), a_failure_on_one_session_does_not_stop_the_next (1338), a_moved_claude_dir_keeps_every_session_whose_transcript_is_still_on_disk (1337). 'git diff ccb3bf2..HEAD -- crates/terminus-core/tests crates/terminus/tests | grep -E "^-[^-]"' printed nothing, so no assertion or expected value was removed or changed.

truths.truth: The EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN guard on ENTITY_VALUES_SQL passes on the tree, asserting idx_entities_turn is used and idx_entities_lookup never is
truths.evidence: ENTITY_VALUES_SQL ('turns t CROSS JOIN entities e ON e.turn_id = t.id') at crates/terminus-core/src/observe/mechanical.rs:252-256, prepared by entity_values at mechanical.rs:271. Guard test a_plan_that_starts_from_the_sessions_turns (mechanical.rs:469-491) builds a store from crate::store::schema::CREATE_SQL in a tempdir, plans the constant itself, and asserts on index names only (mechanical.rs:484, 488). It passed in the merged suite (full-suite.log line 681: 'test observe::mechanical::tests::a_plan_that_starts_from_the_sessions_turns ... ok').

truths.truth: With the query put back to its kind-driven shape, the guard test fails
truths.evidence: In an isolated git-archive copy of HEAD (own CARGO_TARGET_DIR and build-dir; repo untouched), the FROM line was changed to 'FROM entities e JOIN turns t ON t.id = e.turn_id'. Then 'cargo test --offline -p terminus-core --all-features --lib observe::mechanical::tests::a_plan_that_starts_from_the_sessions_turns' exited 101: 'panicked at crates/terminus-core/src/observe/mechanical.rs:483:9: the plan never uses idx_entities_turn: ["SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_entities_lookup (kind=?)", "SEARCH t USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)"]'.

truths.truth: The observe query reads a session's entities through its turns in both observations regenerate and the ordinary pass, with no new index and DERIVED_SCHEMA still 5
truths.evidence: The only entity_values callers are mechanical::observe (crates/terminus-core/src/observe/mechanical.rs:131-132). It is reached by write_one (crates/terminus-core/src/observe/mod.rs:173, ordinary pass via observe_new, called at crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/pass.rs:364) and by rewrite_one (observe/mod.rs:280, regenerate, called from crates/terminus/src/cmd/observations.rs:155). 'git diff --stat ccb3bf2..HEAD' over store/, observe/mod.rs, cmd/observations.rs, recall/, show.rs and mcp/ printed nothing (exit 0). DERIVED_SCHEMA = 5 at crates/terminus-core/src/store/open.rs:31. crates/terminus/tests/observations.rs passed 7/0 in the merged suite (log 416-427). On the scratch store, sqlite3 EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN of the new shape gave 'SEARCH t USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_turns_1 (session_key=?)' then 'SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_entities_turn (turn_id=?)'.

truths.truth: The sweep never fails the pass: a failure is one line in runs.error, and a healthy sweep writes nothing to error or notes
truths.evidence: pass.rs:345-347 maps any Err into Summary.continuations (pass.rs:61-64), and runs.rs:84 adds it to error after feedback and before outcomes. Healthy: both CLI passes in truth 2 left runs 'error=NULL notes=NULL'. Failure: a scratch binary with 'Err(rusqlite::Error::InvalidQuery)?' injected at the top of fill_continuations ran 'terminus ingest' with exit 0, committed the file (files_committed=1, sessions=1) and wrote exactly 'error=[continuation links could not be filled: sqlite: Query is not read-only] notes=NULL'.

truths.truth: Only the tree pass runs the sweep, and it reaches turns only through existing indexes (no SCAN of turns)
truths.evidence: 'grep -rn fill_continuations\(' over crates/ shows the definition (ingest/mod.rs:1559) and one call, inside 'impl Walk for Tree' after_walk (pass.rs:345). No call from driver::drive, the backfill walk, the named-file walk or reindex. The driver module doc lists it among the tree-only steps (crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/driver.rs:6-10). EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on the scratch store (sqlite3 CLI 3.54.0; the bundled SQLite is 3.53.2, but each statement is an equality lookup and the select pins order with CROSS JOIN): sweep select 'SEARCH m USING INDEX idx_session_meta_continues_from' then 'SEARCH t USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_turns_1 (session_key=? AND turn_seq=?)'; parent lookup 'SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_turns_uuid (uuid=?)' then 'SEARCH m USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_meta_1'; update 'SEARCH session_meta USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_meta_1'. No SCAN in any of them.
